Encrypted Page

AES-256-GCM · PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA256 · 600,000 iterations

This page ships ciphertext only. Enter your passphrase to decrypt its contents locally in your browser. The passphrase is never stored and never sent anywhere — there are no network calls.

A wrong passphrase produces an error and no content — decryption is all-or-nothing (AES-GCM integrity check). The decrypted payload renders inside a script-disabled sandboxed frame.
